contract_templates_catalog.content: DocuSign template catalog (active): TPL-ENT-ANNUAL-v4 'Enterprise Annual MSA + Order Form' (US, deals >$150k); TPL-ENT-MULTI-v2 'Enterprise Multi-Year MSA' (multi-year terms); TPL-MIDMKT-v3 'Mid-Market Order Form' (deals $25k-$150k); TPL-SMB-v6 'SMB Self-Serve Agreement' (deals <$25k); TPL-RENEWAL-v3 'Renewal Addendum' (existing customers). Each template auto-populates account name, amount, and term from the opportunity.

contract_routing_guidelines.content: Contract Routing Guidelines v9 (2026-Q2): (1) Select template by deal size and term per catalog. (2) US Enterprise New Business >$150k -> TPL-ENT-ANNUAL-v4. (3) Signer must be the account's Authorized Signatory; if not on file, the Primary Contact may be used ONLY after AE confirms signing authority. (4) Deals >$100k require AE sign-off recorded before send. (5) Large deals (>$100k) require a #deals-won channel alert AFTER the envelope is sent, never before.

Note: per legal, MSAs require General Counsel signature for deals over $100k.

tools.name: find_deal_closed_email
tools.description: Locate and read the inbound 'Deal Closed' notification email in the sales-ops inbox, including the opportunity reference, account, amount, and contact details.

tools.name: lookup_opportunity_record
tools.description: Retrieve the Salesforce opportunity record matching the notification, including stage, amount, owner, primary contact, and current contract-sent status.

tools.name: list_contract_templates
tools.description: Read the catalog of active DocuSign contract templates and their applicability rules by deal size and term.

tools.name: check_contract_routing_guidelines
tools.description: Apply the contract routing guidelines to determine the correct template, required signer authority, and pre-send sign-off conditions for this deal.

tools.name: lookup_account_signer_directory
tools.description: Look up the account's contacts and authorized signatory to confirm the correct recipient for the contract.

tools.name: draft_contract_send_package
tools.description: Assemble a draft contract-send package summarizing the matched opportunity, selected template, intended signer, deal amount, and any unmet guideline conditions, for the user's approval before anything is sent.

tools.name: list_slack_channels
tools.description: Read the index of available Slack channels and their audiences for reference.

tools.name: send_contract_via_docusign
tools.description: Create and send a DocuSign envelope from the selected template to the signer for signature.

tools.name: update_opportunity_record
tools.description: Update the Salesforce opportunity record with the contract that was sent and the signer details.

tools.name: post_deal_alert_to_slack
tools.description: Post a large-deal alert announcing the closed deal, account, and amount to the #deals-won Slack channel.
